_note: Two Baidu photos — the truss-vaulted check-in hall and an Air China A320 in 'Ningbo' livery at the terminal — accompany the Esri World Imagery satellite view.

ngb-baidu-1.webp.zh: 宁波栎社机场的值机大厅：白色管桁架拱顶下是一排排值机柜台与排队栏杆，天光从两侧高窗照入。
ngb-baidu-1.webp.en: Ningbo Lishe's check-in hall — rows of counters and queue barriers under a white tubular-truss vault, daylight from high windows on both sides.

ngb-baidu-2.webp.zh: 国航「宁波」号彩绘 A320 滑行经过宁波栎社机场航站楼，屋顶上是红色「宁波」二字，右侧立着机场塔台。
ngb-baidu-2.webp.en: An Air China A320 in its colourful 'Ningbo' livery taxiing past Ningbo Lishe's terminal — red 'Ningbo' characters on the roofline and the control tower to the right.

ngb-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，宁波栎社国际机场（NGB）的机场布局与周边环境清晰可辨。
ngb-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, the layout of Ningbo Lishe International Airport (NGB) and its surroundings are clearly visible.
